_comment: Settings for src/comic_reader.py, the image -> text stage, and
This file is tracked and must stay publishable: nothing here may name a
real site. The site's address lives in comic_site.json, which is
gitignored -- see comic_site.example.json and copy it to start.
glossary: names and story terms the OCR segmenter must never split.
Nothing in a page's text distinguishes 'sap in' from 'block him from', so a
lowercase name like Ashbern reads as two English words and only this list
keeps it whole. Add to it whenever a recap mangles a name.
tile_height: a continuous scroll is cut into tiles this tall because the
detector only handles regions roughly the size of its input. Overlap keeps
a bubble straddling a seam whole in at least one tile; duplicates across a
seam are dropped when the transcript is assembled.
comics_dir / transcripts_dir / novels_dir resolve relative to the repo
